capabilities: Pan spreadsheets by dragging with touch or pen
Pan spreadsheets with Alt/Option + left-click drag on desktop
Hand off copy requests to Pointix Sheet Copy on double tap
disambiguation: Not a general vault navigation tool; it only pans spreadsheets inside the Sheet Plus plugin.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Optional Ko-fi donations do not unlock features.
intentEvidence: A lightweight companion plugin for Obsidian + Sheet Plus that improves spreadsheet navigation without replacing Sheet Plus.
motivation: The README states: "Sheet Plus is powerful, but some workflows benefit from a dedicated pan gesture, especially on touch devices and when working with large sheets."
problem: Sheet Plus spreadsheets lack a dedicated pan gesture, which makes navigating large sheets awkward on touch devices.

relations.evidence: improves spreadsheet navigation without replacing Sheet Plus
Double tap can hand off a copy request to the separate Pointix Sheet Copy plugin.

summary: Pan-gesture companion for Sheet Plus spreadsheets, adding touch/pen dragging and Alt/Option + left-drag panning on desktop.
